claim_ceiling: Repairs only Active Path scan integrity identity, reference classification truth, and the exporter compatibility binding required to consume that repaired scanner. It does not change ZIP handoff behavior, owners, helpers, routes, Bank, Continuous Run, storage, or persisted user data.

diagnostic_matrix_update.rationale: Fresh iPhone evidence proved the scanner inherited an old persisted route-receipt manifest SHA and treated static comment/output-only names as required-current 412 blockers. The browser matrix seeds a stale route receipt, serves a different manifest, injects comment/output-only names, and requires exact served-manifest digest binding with zero false current blockers.

observed_facts.fact: Pre-repair integrityEvidence read pmp_route_guardian_v22_receipt from localStorage, so a fresh scan could report an old manifest SHA.
The permanent browser proof seeds a stale route-receipt SHA and requires the report to equal the digest of newly served A-003 manifest bytes instead.
The browser proof injects retired-comment markers and weak metadata/packet/report output basenames as 412 endpoints and requires that none be scanned as runtime dependencies.

inferred_conclusions.conclusion: Hashing the exact served manifest response bytes during the requested scan binds Atlas identity to that scan rather than to prior persisted route evidence.

Removing static comments before lexical discovery and treating generic output basenames as weak unless referenced through an explicit load operation prevents non-runtime text from becoming fail-closed current blockers without suppressing real fetch/import/worker dependencies.

cases: stale persisted route receipt contains a different manifest SHA
served A-003 manifest bytes are hashed during the exact scan
block comments contain retired JSON artifact names
weak generic metadata.json, packet.json, report.json strings exist
explicit fetch strong-output.json remains a runtime reference
false blocker endpoints return HTTP 412 if mistakenly requested
freeze gate requires served manifest binding to exact scan ID
